findings.title: Application configured for public network exposure
findings.description: The laboratory application is configured to listen on 0.0.0.0 and is therefore not restricted to a local interface.
findings.impact: Unrestricted network exposure can make an application reachable by unintended clients.
findings.remediation: Restrict the application to an explicitly approved network interface or controlled security boundary.

findings.title: Storage configured without encryption
findings.description: Laboratory storage is explicitly configured without encryption.
findings.impact: Unencrypted stored data may be exposed if the underlying storage is accessed without authorization.
findings.remediation: Enable encryption for stored application data and use managed encryption keys where appropriate.

findings.title: Excessive wildcard permissions
findings.description: The laboratory role is configured with wildcard permissions.
findings.impact: Excessive permissions increase the potential impact of credential or workload compromise.
findings.remediation: Apply least-privilege permissions limited to the resources and actions required by the application.
